description: Search the knowledge graph for entities whose name, type or observations contain the query (case-insensitive). Use this when you have a keyword, a topic or part of a name but not the exact entity names. Prefer open_nodes when you already know the exact names, and use read_graph only when you need the whole graph. Returns the matching entities and every relation that touches one of them.

limit.description: Return at most this many matching entities (the first matches, in stored order), with the relations that touch them. Omit to return every match.

observationLimit.description: Return at most this many observations per entity (the first ones, in the order they were added) and add each entity's total as observationCount. Use 0 for names, types and counts only: a cheap overview of a large graph, after which open_nodes reads the entities you need in full. Omit to return every observation.

query.description: The search query to match against entity names, types, and observation content

name: search_nodes

observationCount.description: How many observations the entity holds in total; present only when observationLimit was given

observations.description: An array of observation contents associated with the entity

from.description: The name of the entity where the relation starts

to.description: The name of the entity where the relation ends

title: Search Nodes
